data.name: Awadini
data.gender_notes: Awadini is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'awadana' which means 'to awake, to revive, or to make something live again'. This name holds a significant spiritual meaning in Islam, representing the awakening of one's faith and the revival of their spiritual connection with Allah. The name Awadini carries the meaning “Awakening, Revival” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awadini usually hope their child will grow to embody awakening, revival and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual awakening and revival of faith.
data.etymology: Awadini belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Awakening, Revival.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awadini total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
